name: mbpfan
description: Containerized mbpfan (for Macs running Linux, to control fans) NOTE: the executable in the container was compiled by bplein from https://github.com/linux-on-mac/mbpfan. Uses the Ubuntu repository version of https://github.com/linux-on-mac/mbpfan Need to create a configuration file with the following contents and mount it in the container as a volume in the container under /etc/mbpfan.conf: File contents of /mnt/user/appdata/mbpfan/mbpfan.conf (example on a Late 2012 i7 Mac mini) is available at: https://github.com/bplein/mbpfan/blob/master/etc/mbpfan.conf
